cases.note: Remote identity and the locally selected federation policy version are exact inputs to the trust decision.
Suspended, revoked and expired relationships do not produce an active trust decision.
Trust is an interaction/identity result; local grant, mount and target policy remain mandatory.
Federated memory access delegates the local decision to the G4 source-grant/target-mount intersection.
A trusted remote principal cannot be rebound to a different source workspace or shared object.
Relationship evidence is metadata; no transitive re-share or remote authority transfer is exposed.

known_limitations: The implementation is an in-memory domain boundary; durable relationship/decision/audit persistence is not implemented.
Transport, cryptographic signature verification, remote protocol adapters, provider/export wiring and DataPolicy classification enforcement remain open.
This fixture is executable evidence for the bounded G5 slice and does not qualify FEDERATION, TRUSTED or a v0.4 release.
